**Hot reload brings back your CSS and components.** While `xl dev` was running, a saved `style.css` or `components\*.js` never reached the open app: the WebView reused them from its cache until Excel restarted, so a screen could open half new and half old. The cache is now off while a project is served from disk. A delivered app keeps it.

**No save is missed.** The file watcher could lose a change when an editor saved by writing a temporary file and renaming it over the real one (which is how AI tools save), when a change landed during a rebuild, or in a "save all" burst. Changes are now queued the moment they happen, and a whole burst becomes a single reload.

**A hiccup no longer stops the reload.** A failed check after hot reload had already worked used to switch it off until Excel restarted. It now retries.

Projects created before this version need one `xl build` to get the new bridge. Until then they open normally, just with the cache on.
